content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"Yes: the judge text adjudicates D5 vs C5 by declaring the sign's sense open after CR2 G answers the almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, rather than weighing the pressing side's own chain against the link by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'leaving the sign's sense open' vs the rule's retired 'stating-verse test': read either as a verse-level open-sense reason for rejecting the link (breach) or as a conclusion after chain-vs-chain footing (clean); the text gives only the open-sense reason.","why":"The judge gives 'leaving the sign's sense open' as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which applies the retired open-sense/stating-verse test to the link instead of weighing the pressing side's own chain by footing."}
